post.summary: Update status of accreditation - PRINTED, DISTRIBUTED, REVOKED
post.description:
The statuses are intended to carry following meanings
	1. PRINTED - Badge has been printed
	2. DEPT_DISTRIBUTED - Badge has been distributed to concerned department
	3. DISTRIBUTED - Badge has been handed over to the person
	4. REVOKED - Person's accreditation has been deleted and he no longer have any access to the event.NOTE: This SHOULD NOT BE USED to INVALIDATE a badge.
